html:
SMTO-OUT-0006 — SMTO couldn't finish this Task's summary

GUID: 96ce308f-5028-4c5c-ab52-b559944957ae
Slug: summary-generation-failed
Domain: OUT · Subsystem: out

What happened

  • Writing the summary for this Task failed or was cut short, for example by a restart. The Task's work and results are saved separately and weren't affected.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Read the Task's reply and its activity to see what was done. The results are kept apart from the summary, so they're complete without it.
  2. Reload the page and check whether a summary has appeared under the reply. SMTO can rebuild an interrupted summary from the saved results when the Task is opened again.
  3. If there's still no summary and you want one, select Retry summary under the reply. This only rewrites the summary text; it doesn't run any of the Task's actions again.

What success looks like

  • A summary appears under the reply and the Retry summary button goes away.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't run the Task again to get a summary; that would repeat its work.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A task summary request failed, or an in-progress summary was recovered as interrupted; the failure is recorded only as a fixed category (provider, schema, internal or persistence) after the task's work was already recorded.

What this means

  • A retained in-progress summary is recovered as interrupted, or summary creation catches provider/schema/internal/persistence failure and records a bounded category. Output extraction, rendering and summaries do not own execution truth. Their failure cannot turn a completed operation into unexecuted work or justify replay; retained exact receipts remain authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • A retained in-progress summary is recovered as interrupted, or summary creation catches provider/schema/internal/persistence failure and records a bounded category.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the summary status and validation_stage/error_kind alongside original task receipts.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the existing task output and the summary's error_kind and validation_stage from failure_diagnostic, then POST /api/agent/native/<request_id>/summary again if a summary is still needed. This retries presentation only; completed task operations remain preserved.
  • Inspect the existing task output and request summary generation again if still needed. This retries presentation only; completed task operations remain preserved.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • An explicitly requested presentation-only retry produces a valid summary without replaying completed operations.

What not to do

  • Do not submit a stale identifier or revision after another actor changed the resource.

Technical notes

  • Output extraction, rendering and summaries do not own execution truth. Their failure cannot turn a completed operation into unexecuted work or justify replay; retained exact receipts remain authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
